summary: The change of atlas is now proved once for `SectionChartData`, but the `atlasEquiv` block (equivalence plus refl/symm/trans/comp lemmas) is still duplicated per instance. The new half-plane null-set lemmas are unused special cases of `ReadsFrom.coord_ae_eq`, and this PR also leaves the boundaryless `Measure.lean` versions with no users.
